1935, July
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 11 Cont.
July 3rd Byron Miller - 24 - T.B. in Kiefer Hospital - Very little hope for him.
H. A. Vaughan - 61 - (a Cath.) scientist
Abraham W. Jarvis - 68 - stroke 8 yrs. - 4 yrs. in bed - now out of mind.
Page 12 July Mr. & Mrs. Wm. Kestel - past middle age - have 9 children - she a Lutheran , he 0
Kennedy - congress-man - twin Br. given up.
Angeline Woida - 16 - deaf & dumb - lost tonsils when 5 - could say some words before.
Page 13 July 10 Mary M. Kowicz - 35 - Thanksgiving for position .... further success Examination To-day ( 10th)
9 Mr. Brewer - 56 - operation July 9th
Felician Sister - Court Case - V. Mother Mary deSales -
9 Mrs. Olive Estabrook - about 58 - threatened with loss of breast believed cancerous - 13 - Reported .. . ! ! ! No cancer wonderful results Wm. J. O'Neil - 50 - fears 2nd operation on neck. - has wife & 8 depending.
Wm. Joseph Blesch - 7 - from N.Y. injured at birth, mentally weak ... B. Miller ( from last week) 24 - recovering - now able to take nourish- Mrs. Cath. Connolly - 68 - cancer of stomach - had been to three hosp- itals; All pronounced her as case of stomach ...... Enrolled in Ser. Mass As'n, May Ist - now out of danger without operat'n - starts perp(5) To-day with 1.00.
